items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: what about Cap, the Cap Brothers, did they have Decca or what? I know we did some things for them. Yeah, we did quite a few things for them.

ctx.x: I'd have to go look it up. I forget.

I don't know. But I know some of his things were on Vocalion, but as I recall, we recorded mostly for Decca and Columbia back there at that time, and what about Cap, the Cap Brothers, did they have Decca or what? I know we did some things for them. Yeah, we did quite a few things for them.
But we recorded in New York; most all the time our recordings were --
